title: Counter Test Step
statement: Let $W$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine, let $a$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a list of schedule symbols, let $B$ be a base controller configuration, and let $u,g$ be integers. From the counter-test phase, one schedule step enters the leftward-seek phase exactly when the base unary-counter tape contains a unit marker at position $u$; otherwise the controller halts. In either case, the unary-counter and guide heads remain at $u$ and $g$, respectively.
hypotheses_covered: $W$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
$x$ is a list of schedule symbols
replaced:
For every macrostep configuration in the counter-test phase with unary head $u$ and
guide head $g$: if the base's unary tape holds a unit marker at $u$, one step of the
schedule controller enters the leftward-seek phase; otherwise it halts.  In both
cases every head stays in place.
